title: FL-1 Electronic Load Telemetry Response
description: Schema for READ TELEMETRY JSON response from FL-1 Electronic Load + Discharge Board Rev A.

ts_ms.description: Firmware timestamp in milliseconds since boot (time.ticks_ms()).

channels.description: Telemetry for each load channel (4 elements, index 0=ch1).

v.description: DUT terminal voltage as measured by INA219 bus voltage register, in Volts.

i_ma.description: Load current measured via 100mOhm sense resistor, in milliamps.

p_mw.description: Instantaneous power dissipation (v * i_ma), in milliwatts.

energy_mj.description: Accumulated energy since last ENABLE command, in millijoules.

peak_i_ma.description: Peak current seen since last ENABLE, in milliamps.

peak_v.description: Peak voltage seen since last ENABLE, in Volts.

temp_c.description: MOSFET heatsink temperature from NTC thermistor, in Celsius.

coil_v.description: 5V coil rail voltage measured by INA219 at addr 0x46, in Volts.

coil_ma.description: Total coil rail current (all relay coils) via 50mOhm shunt, in milliamps.

fan_rpm.description: Fan speed in RPM (from tachometer input GP20).
